notes.title: SURPRISE! Game has been released NOW!
notes.content: [p]SURPRISE! Due to our own whims and in an unexpected fashion, Plumbum has been officially released today!![/p][p]Enjoy the full game plunging through its corridors and trying your luck in its ultra-violence, since now you can fully grasp the whole game as intended![/p][p]Be sure to also join our official Discord server for any updates and follow us on Bluesky as well as our other social media![/p][p]WELCOME TO ULTRA-VIOLENCE. WELCOME TO PLUMBUM.[/p]

notes.title: Support our game on itch.io!
notes.content:
Hello, and welcome all to Plumbum.

We're going to have to wait a tiny bit to get the demo on Steam, but in the meantime, you can not just get the demo of Plumbum on itch.io but also get early access to Steam keys for this game in the case you're donating there!

This will help immensely to financially support this game's development as I have to cover some personal finances, but also support financially other of our games' development as well. Also, for higher bidders of the itch.io donations, you can get the original soundtrack of the game.

So, while you wait for the Steam demo to appear, why not try the demo on itch.io and donate there as well?

Go [url=https://jmaagames.itch.io/plumbum]here[/url] to get to our itch.io page!

You can find the main hub of information about Plumbum at [url=https://jmaa.tv/plumbum]jmaa.tv/plumbum[/url] too.

Thank you, and see you soon!
